national_news.title: 18th BRICS Summit Commences in New Delhi under India's 2026 Chairship
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit is hosted at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, under India's 2026 Chairship with the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
This marks India's fourth BRICS Chairship (previously chaired in 2012, 2016, and 2021) and features participation from 11 member nations alongside heads of UN, WHO, and New Development Bank (NDB).
Originally formed in 2006 and expanded with South Africa in 2010, BRICS added five new full members in January 2024: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE.

national_news.title: India Enters Women's Asia Cup 2026 Final after Defeating Bangladesh
bullets: India defeated Bangladesh by 40 runs in the first semi-final of the Women's Asia Cup 2026 held in Dubai to secure a spot in the tournament final.
Opener Shafali Verma was named Player of the Match for her top-scoring performance of 64 runs off 40 balls, leading India to 149/6.
Spinner Deepti Sharma took 3 wickets for India, restricting Bangladesh to 109/7 in their 20 overs.

national_news.title: PIB Organizes First Media Exposure Tour from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) concluded its first-ever exposure tour for media representatives from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat to foster national integration.

The delegation visited key infrastructure and developmental landmarks including Dholera Greenfield Smart City, GIFT City, Sabarmati Multimodal Transport Hub, AMUL, Sardar Sarovar Dam, and the Statue of Unity.
The program facilitated cultural exchange between North-Eastern and Western India, including interactions with the Rathwa tribal community in Ekta Nagar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Month-Long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' Across All Districts
bullets: Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting to finalize preparations for the state-wide 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan', scheduled from September 17 to October 17, 2026.

The campaign encompasses 13 key components, including 'Aashirwad ka Diya' (lamp distribution via Jeevika and PDS), 'Seva Chitra' school competitions, and 'Aangan ka Milan' honoring Anganwadi and ASHA workers.

Key public mobilization activities include 'Seva Jyoti Yatra' rallies with 'Mera Yuva Bharat' volunteers taking the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' pledge, alongside 'Seva Mera Yogdan' sanitation and conservation drives across assembly constituencies.
